project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh token) with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: Accounts and transactions API
components.description: REST endpoints to list accounts, balances and paginated transaction history, with filtering by date range and category and idempotent transfer requests.

components.name: PSD2 consent and open banking connectors
components.description: Consent lifecycle management for third-party providers, strong customer authentication challenges, and connectors to the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 interface.

components.name: Push notifications service
components.description: Transaction alerts and security notifications delivered through Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service, with user-level preferences.

components.name: Audit logging and monitoring
components.description: Immutable audit log of sensitive operations, structured application logs and dashboards with alerting on authentication failures and latency.
